scope: Workflow lint rules in policy/ci/workflow.rego, mapped to supply-chain controls. Rule logic is original; zizmor and actionlint cover overlapping ground and are not replaced. Mapping is a draft for a human assessor, not an attestation.

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: PS.1.1 requires least privilege so only authorized personnel, tools and services can reach code; a workflow-wide write token is broader than that. Requirement text read from the fetched PDF, the application to CI tokens is a paraphrase.

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: PO.5.1 text: Separate and protect each environment involved in software development. Treating job scoping as environment separation is a paraphrase.

rows.check: third-party action not pinned to a 40-character sha

controls.label: GROUNDED
controls.basis: PW.4.4 text, read from the fetched PDF: Verify that acquired commercial, open-source, and all other third-party software components comply with the requirements, as defined by the organization, throughout their life cycles. A mutable tag cannot be verified at a point in time.

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: PW.4.1 covers acquiring and maintaining well-secured third-party components; sha pinning as the means is a paraphrase.

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: Requirement text: any external influence on the build was specifically requested by the build itself. A moving tag lets the action author change the build without a change in this repo. Mapping is a paraphrase.

rows.check: pull_request_target combined with checkout of the PR head

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: Requirement text: the build platform ensured that the build steps ran in an isolated environment, free of unintended external influence. Untrusted PR code running in a privileged trigger context is external influence the build did not request. Mapping is a paraphrase.

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: Separating untrusted contributions from the privileged build environment; paraphrase of PO.5.1.

rows.check: github.event expression expanded inside a run script

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: Attacker-controlled event text becomes script source, an external influence on the build the build did not request. Mapping is a paraphrase.

controls.label: INFERRED
controls.basis: Keeps untrusted input out of the build environment's command channel; paraphrase of PO.5.1.
